questions: Do you remain fully conscious and aware during the jerks?
Do the jerks occur only when you are falling asleep or already asleep?
Are the jerks triggered by sudden sounds, touch, movement, or being startled?
Do they occur mainly when you are moving, reaching, or holding something?
Do they occur repeatedly in a regular rhythm or in clusters?
Have you ever had a longer episode involving loss of awareness, staring, collapse, or unresponsiveness?
Have you ever bitten your tongue or cheek during an episode?
Have you ever lost bladder or bowel control during an episode?
Do you feel confused, unusually sleepy, or have a severe headache after an episode?
Do the jerks occur more often after sleep deprivation, alcohol use, or missed meals?
Did these jerks begin after starting, stopping, or changing the dose of any medication or recreational drug?
Are you currently taking antidepressants, antipsychotics, stimulants, opioids, anticonvulsants, or sedatives?
Have the jerks been progressively worsening or becoming more frequent?
Do you have weakness, numbness, problems with balance, speech, vision, or memory?
Have you recently had a fever, serious illness, head injury, kidney or liver problems, or exposure to toxins?
Has anyone in your family had epilepsy or similar involuntary movements?
